name: smwsprites-brutal-bill
title: Brutal Bill
description:
This is a recreation of the famous Homing Bullet Bill seen in many hacks. Affectionately dubbed the "Brutal Bill", as it is based on a sprite made by Carol and debuted in Brutal Mario.

This was made partially because Carol's was never released with his explicit permission, and is considered a leaked resource. It uses none of Carol's code, so it's not 1:1, but it is close enough that most people will never notice.

This sprite was also posted to my Patreon. Should anything happen to this submission, it can be found there as well.
